serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: What are you doing here? 
Hobo: Why are you asking me? This is happening in your head!
You: Can’t you just answer properly? After all, you are in my head. Shouldn’t you just, like, listen to me or something?
#Hobo.Face.angry
Hobo: This is exactly the problem with you people! You got a little luckier than me, and you think you deserve some special treatment!
